mapper.select: SELECT pro.id, pro.code, pro.purchase_order_code, pro.supplier_name, pro.approve_status, pro.invalid_status, prod.sku_no, pro.bill_date, pro.return_warehouse_name, prod.return_qty, pro.return_remark, pro.return_mode, pro.purchase_user_id, pro.return_user_name, prod.remark, pro.approve_user_name, pro.create_user_name, pro.create_time, prod.purchase_order_detail_id FROM po_return_detail prod LEFT JOIN po_return pro ON prod.main_id = pro.id AND prod.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pro.is_deleted = FALSE AND pro.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}

select pr.supplier_id,count(distinct pr.id) as qc_return_count,sum(prd.return_qty) as qc_return_qty from po_return pr inner join po_return_detail prd on prd.main_id = pr.id where pr.approve_status = 'approve' and pr.is_deleted = false
and pr.supplier_id in
#{item}
and pr.source_type in
#{item}
AND pr.bill_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} AND (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > pr.bill_date
group by pr.supplier_id

SELECT pro.id, prod.id AS detailId, pro.confirm_date AS confirmDate, pro.code AS code, pro.purchase_order_code AS purchaseOrderCode, pro.confirm_status AS confirmStatus, prod.sku_id AS skuId, prod.sku_no AS skuNo, prod.return_qty AS returnQty, pro.return_remark AS returnRemark, prod.remark AS remark, pro.return_user_name AS returnUserName, pro.unusual_type AS unusualType, pro.unusual_remark AS unusualRemark, pro.bill_date AS billDate, pro.source_type AS sourceType FROM po_return_detail prod INNER JOIN po_return pro ON prod.main_id = pro.id AND prod.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pro.is_deleted = FALSE AND pro.approve_status = 'approve'
and pro.code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.code}::text,'%')
and prod.sku_no in
#{item}
and pro.confirm_status = #{params.confirmStatus}
and pro.bill_date >= #{params.billDateList[0]} and (#{params.billDateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > pro.bill_date
and pro.return_remark ILIKE concat('%',#{params.returnRemark}::text,'%')
and pro.source_type != 'qcInfo'
and pro.source_type = 'qcInfo'
and pro.unusual_type = #{params.unusualType}
and pro.return_remark ILIKE concat('%',#{params.returnRemark}::text,'%')
and pro.unusual_remark ILIKE concat('%',#{params.unusualRemark}::text,'%')
and prod.remark ILIKE concat('%',#{params.remark}::text,'%')
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
pro.create_time desc,pro.id
SELECT confirm_status AS tabFlag, count(*) AS count FROM po_return WHERE is_deleted=FALSE GROUP BY confirm_status
